description: Generate per-run credentials and minimal first-start authentication config on the host, start the five real services, perform supported-API domain seeding from lab-controller, and prove baseline_verified idempotently.
acceptance: A clean marked lab reaches process_alive, api_live, api_ready, and baseline_verified for all five real services without UI clicks.
Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, and Jellyfin use documented pinned-version first-start authentication and supported APIs for domain seeding.
Generated credentials remain outside Git and do not appear in stdout, logs, Compose output, inspect data, diagnostics, snapshots, or evidence under direct, encoded, quoted, or URL-escaped forms.
Bootstrap is idempotent and a second run produces no normalized configuration drift.
Prowlarr uses only the local mock indexer and local application links; Jellyfin scans no host or private media.
Runtime inspect matches readiness and security matrices.
